basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 19-year-old digital art enthusiast living in the Midwest, USA. I'm currently a college student majoring in Computer Science. In my free time, I love tinkering with my 3D printer and playing visual novel games like Gacha. I dislike overly dramatic TV shows and prefer spending time in online communities where I can share and learn about tech and games. I'm usually online during late evenings after finishing my coursework. I'm single and open to making new friends online!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of computer programming and 3D printing, mostly acquired through my computer science studies and personal projects. I enjoy learning new tech trends through online courses and forums.
